inputs.original_text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s denial of the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations around the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project doesn’t clear anything up. Calling the questions “political” looks like a way to discredit scrutiny before anyone can follow where the money and benefits might lead. The real story may be who needs this project—and the questions about it—to stay out of view.
inputs.modified_text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s denial over the Rs 700 crore allegations isn’t an answer—it’s a way to steer attention away from the proposed Cooperative Department software project and who stands to benefit. Dismissing the questions as “political” only makes the maneuver more suspicious: it frames scrutiny as illegitimate before anyone can trace where the money leads. The people protecting this project may be just as important as the people promoting it.
